deep-breathing.name: 4-7-8 deep breathing
deep-breathing.description: Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8. Repeat 4 times.

body-scan.name: Body Scan Meditation
body-scan.description: Lie down, close your eyes and scan each part of your body from head to toe.

mindfulness.name: Mindfulness: be present
mindfulness.description: Notice your surroundings: 5 things you see, 4 sounds, 3 touches, 2 smells, 1 taste.

progressive-muscle.name: Muscle relaxation (PMR)
progressive-muscle.description: Tense and release each muscle group to reduce tension in your body.

gratitude-journal.name: Gratitude journal
gratitude-journal.description: Write down 3 things you are grateful for today to bring more happiness to your life.

mood-diary.name: Mood diary
mood-diary.description: Write freely about how you feel today, without worrying about right or wrong.

positive-affirmation.name: Positive self-talk
positive-affirmation.description: Say or write 5 encouraging sentences to yourself to build confidence.

morning-stretch.name: Morning stretch
morning-stretch.description: Stretch after waking up to get your body and mind ready for the day.

light-walk.name: 15-minute easy walk
light-walk.description: Walk somewhere you like, unhurried, noticing the nature around you.

yoga.name: Relaxing yoga
yoga.description: Basic yoga poses to stretch your muscles and reduce stress. Suitable for everyone.

sunlight.name: Morning sunlight
sunlight.description: Get some gentle morning sun to reset your body clock and boost serotonin.

plant-care.name: Care for plants
plant-care.description: Water or tend to plants. This small activity is great for relieving stress.

digital-detox.name: 30-minute digital detox
digital-detox.description: Put your phone down for 30 minutes and enjoy a screen-free activity to calm your mind.

t0.title: Get enough sleep
t0.desc: Sleeping 7-9 hours a night helps your brain recover and handle stress better.

t1.title: Eat healthy food
t1.desc: Foods with omega-3 and vitamin B12 help strengthen your mental health.

t2.title: Talk to someone you trust
t2.desc: Sharing your feelings with someone you trust relieves more pressure than you think.

activity.title: Relaxation Activity Tracker
activity.subtitle: Do the suggested activities, tick them off when done and collect points to care for your mental health every day
